Ava (DevEx): Hey all — about to open my first PR and want to follow team norms. Quick Qs: branch naming, squash vs merge, and any non-obvious lint rules?
Rajat: welcome aboard! Branch pattern is `feat/<TICKET>-short-desc` or `fix/<TICKET>-short-desc`. Hotfixes use `hotfix/...`. Keep it concise and hyphenated.
Priya: also use `draft/` prefix for WIP branches. Include the Jira ID like `feat/RED-4321-add-kv-cache`.
Ava (DevEx): PR template asks for "what changed" and "how to test" — anything else reviewers expect?
Devon: mention perf impact if touching runtime loops, and list manual infra steps if any. Small focused PRs get faster reviews.
Rajat: review policy: 2 approvals for core packages (serving, runtime, infra), 1 approval for docs/ux. Tag owners with @<owner-handle>. Use `needs-review` label when ready.
Ava (DevEx): who owns serving runtime? I'm modifying imports under `serving/runtime`.
Priya: ping @Rajat and @Devon. Add `needs-sandbox` label if it requires dedicated infra to test.
Ava (DevEx): CI failed with eslint errors — any local commands I should run?
Devon: run `yarn lint` and `yarn test:unit` locally. For python infra: `make lint` and `make test`. Example: 
``n# js
yarn install
yarn lint --fix
yarn test:unit --watchAll=false
```
Priya: we have husky hooks too — if pre-commit didn't run, run `npx husky install`.
CI Bot: Build #4521 · PR 17 · lint failed — see https://ci.internal.redwood/4521
Ava (DevEx): ok fixed lint, pushed new commit. One last: do we squash on merge?
Rajat: prefer squash merges for feature branches to keep main clean. For large multi-commit refactors we allow merge commits but require a clear changelog entry.
Priya: add a short changelog blurb in the PR body when it's not a trivial tweak.
Ava (DevEx): thanks — requested reviews from @Rajat and @Devon and marked as draft until CI goes green :thumbsup:
Devon: congrats on first PR! we’ll take a look after CI passes :rocket:
